description: Old site vs dotsy site, five Lighthouse categories. get (default): latest result; run: start a test (minutes); history: last 20 results (`id`: one + state; `compareTo`: changes vs another); `auto` (+`on`): daily check after publish; share: public page + image of the latest LIVE result; unshare: take it down; fix: apply ticked fixes (or `fixes`: shrink, eager_first_image, video_on_tap, load_later; `scripts` [{ref, load}]) to the DRAFT, re-test. engine psi = Google PageSpeed Insights, lh = dotsy speed test (never call it PageSpeed). Quote only scores it returns.

compareTo.description: With action:'history' and id: another result id.
